_comment: This template documents the promptArchitectByRiseupAsia block that installers inject into version.json. Copy this structure into your repository version.json.
_purpose: version.json is the single canonical source of truth for repository versioning, releases, metadata, and cross-repo dependencies. All tools, packages, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, manifests, and AI agents must read this file for version information. To bump or change the version in this repository, update the 'Version' field in this file and run the sync script (e.g. npm run sync).
